_comment: Reviews shown in the slider on the homepage.
HOW TO FILL THIS WITH THE REAL 68 - see README, 'Google reviews'.
Google's public Places API only ever returns 5 reviews and does not
attach reviewer photos, so this file is populated either by a one-off
export from the Google Business Profile API or by a review service.
date     optional, ISO yyyy-mm-dd - shown as 'March 2025'
avatar   optional, path or URL to the reviewer's profile picture
photos   optional, array of image paths the reviewer attached
url      optional, direct link to the review on Google
The three below are the placeholders that were hardcoded on the
homepage. Replace them with the real ones.

reviews.author: Sarah M.
reviews.text: Incredible experience from start to finish. My artist really listened and brought my idea to life exactly how I pictured it.

reviews.author: Jordan T.
reviews.text: Clean studio, welcoming vibes, and seriously talented artists. I've been back three times and I'll keep coming back.

reviews.author: Alex R.
reviews.text: The aftercare instructions they gave me were so thorough. Healed perfectly. I already have my next appointment booked.
